description_en: A stackable dining chair with a thin woven seat, open U-shaped back and outward-offset tubular bamboo legs; the front shows clear space beneath the back, the side reveals nesting offsets in the leg rails, and the rear shows uninterrupted stack clearance below the top rail. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
